title: Brazilian Fish Wrap
description: A flavorful Brazilian-inspired fish wrap with fresh ingredients. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy lunch.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat.
2. Season the fish fillet with salt and pepper.
3. Add the olive oil to the skillet and sear the fish for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, toast the wrap in the oven or on the grill for a few seconds.
5. Slice the avocado, red onion, and tomato.
6. Assemble the wrap by spreading the lime juice on the wrap, then adding the sliced avocado, red onion, and tomato.
7. Once the fish is cooked, place it on top of the vegetables.
8. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve immediately.
